newsitem.title: USA: Everen Capital Corp sets IPO terms.
newsitem.headline: Everen Capital Corp sets IPO terms.

text.p: Everen Capital Corp said it plans to offer four million shares in an estimated range of $17.50 to $19.50 each, according to a statement filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday.
The full-service securities brokerage firm has proposed to list on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "EVR."
The company filed to go public in late July but never disclosed specific terms. A spokeswoman for Everen said the tentative date for the offering is still "to be announced."
